_comment: Example store_layout.json in the shape pipeline/detect_store.py reads. Coords are normalised 0-1 (x from left, y from top). These mirror the calibrated Store 2 defaults, so running with --layout data/store_layout.example.json reproduces the built-in behaviour. The challenge's own store_layout.json can replace this; unknown extra keys (open_hours, etc.) are ignored.
